production_inference_candidate.centering: Pilot population allocation-pooled quantile and analytic winsor means
production_inference_candidate.rng: PCG64DXSM-SeedSequence-v1; seed=1729, stream=outer replication ordinal, spawn_key=(stream,canonical_arm,0 for centers or 1 for noise); fixed chunks of 64; exhaustive 70-label production check holds stream=0 for all labels
production_inference_candidate.inversion: B=1999; tail rank floor((B+1)*alpha/2); opposite order statistics; unresolved tails unbounded, any failed root unavailable; never retry/drop
production_inference_candidate.scope: Pointwise asymptotic candidate; finite-grid calibration unexecuted. All historical reference_derivation and known issue records below describe the preserved baseline.

execution_contract.acceptance: Every frozen gate and repetition must pass; deterministic parity and exhaustive labels are necessary but insufficient.
execution_contract.sampling: Winsor draws sample control then treatment from the original case DGP; each draw invokes the captured-array estimator with its outer ordinal as bootstrap stream, without batching.

reference_derivation.raw_moments: LN: E[X^k]=exp(k*mu+k^2*sigma^2/2); Gamma(2,b): b^k*Gamma(2+k); mixtures: weighted sums.
reference_derivation.cutoff: H(c)=w_c*F_c(c)+w_t*F_t(c)=p; w_g=n_g/(n_c+n_t). Analytic CDF, Brent xtol=1e-12, rtol=1e-13.
reference_derivation.targets: m_t(c)-m_c(c) for additive sidecar; m_t(c)/m_c(c)-1 for relative interval.
reference_derivation.variance: sum_g [a_g^2*Var(W)+b_g^2*F_g*S_g+2*a_g*b_g*S_g*(c-m_g)]/n_g. A/A: A=0; heterogeneous arms: generally A!=0.
reference_derivation.bias: Finite-N estimated-cutoff bias is not corrected or excused. The full IF sets width benchmarks; actual unchanged production intervals must cover independent population truth.
reference_derivation.one_sided: greater alpha=.025 displays two-sided alpha=.05. Bernoulli coverage indicators use exact CP; no fractional observations are coerced into binomial counts.
